hypothesis: Combining generative and discriminative models through adversarial training can improve output quality
prediction: Generated images will have a higher sharpness metric
units_range: 0-1 (sharpness metric, e.g. clarity or variance of Laplacian)
measurement_method: Evaluate generated images using a sharpness metric (e.g. clarity or variance of Laplacian) and compare to baseline generative models
falsification_condition: If the sharpness metric of generated images does not increase by at least 10% compared to baseline generative models after adversarial training
